EDSA corner Mapagmahal Street, Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY DILG OPINION NO. 133 S. 2010 SEP DIR. ROLANDO B. CALABAZARON, CESO Ill Regional Director Region IV-B 3/F Santos & Sons Building 973 Aurora Blvd. cor. Dapdap Street Cubao, Quezon City Dear Director Calabazaron: This has reference to your 01 September 2010 letter regarding your urgent request for guidance on what course of action to take pertaining the impending vacancy in the Office of Rizal, Palawan Municipal Mayor Nicolas T. Montano, Sr. for reason of the latter's arrest for the alleged commission of the crime of rape. In reply thereto, may we direct your attention to Section 46 (a) of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991", which provides the manner of filling a temporary vacancy in the office of the mayor, to wit: "Section 46. Temporary Vacancy in the Office of the Local Chief Executive. - (a) When the governor, city or municipal mayor, or punong barangay is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties for physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence, travel abroad, and suspension from office, the vice-governor, city or municipal vice-mayor, or the highest ranking sangguniang barangay member shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. " In view of the foregoing, Vice-Mayor Beverly B. Huelva shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the municipal mayor, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, AUST RE A. PANADERO Undersecretary j LS/08:rb ADM09-01J5500 doc
